integrity: Analytical proof with exact rational interval checks for a critical bracket and worked comparison; finite checks are ancillary and not a proof of universal statements.
scientific_limitations: Independent identical two-site occupancy, rate-homogeneous conditional Poisson encounters, two confirmations at the same site and a fixed additive time budget. No empirical deployment claim. Historical priority remains qualified against incompletely available generic S-shaped allocation literature.
title: The sharp universal budget for unequal two-site Poisson confirmation
